title: Alıkara
overview: A mysterious corpse draws Chief Inspector Deniz and Psychologist Işık into a grueling struggle. As the investigation deepens, long-hidden traumas from the past come to light, and the hunt for an anonymous killer begins…

title: Last Seen
overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

title: Crew Girl
overview: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

title: Mr. Fanboy
overview: Cast in a BL drama with his idol, devoted fanboy Wan finds his heart pulled in a shocking new direction by the idol's protective partner, Third.

title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

title: You Maniac
overview: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.

title: Mousetrap
overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

title: The Perfect Lie
overview: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
overview: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

title: DANG!
overview: Follow a brother and sister whose fun, messy lives in New York City are interrupted when their worst nightmare comes true: Their high-achieving older sister shows up and wants to hang out with them.

title: Blossom Through the Cloud
overview: Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

title: In My Prime
overview: In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

title: One-Room TA
overview:
Coming back to college as a sophomore, U-yun meets Jin-hyeong, a TA with a mysterious charm. After U-yun blurts out a sudden confession, the two unexpectedly end up living together in a studio apartment.

A week into living together, U-yun goes in for a deep, passionate kiss, but Jin-hyeong asks him to wait, revealing he has a very specific "fantasy" about physical intimacy.

Just what kind of fantasy is he talking about!? Will they be able to push past all their wild fantasies and delusions to successfully survive their first night together?

"I just want to know you better."

title: Collision
overview: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

title: All the Truth in My Lies
overview: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.
